001package org.clafer.lsp;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
006import org.eclipse.lsp4j.Position;
007import org.eclipse.lsp4j.Range;
008
009/**
010 * Converts between the frontend's positions and LSP's, on the text of a
011 * document.
012 * <p>
013 * The frontend's lines and columns start at 1, and its columns are the
014 * compiler's: a tab moves to the column after the next multiple of 8, and
015 * every other character, a carriage return included, is one column. LSP's
016 * lines and characters start at 0, and a character is a UTF-16 code unit, as
017 * a Java {@code char} is.
018 */
019public final class Positions {
020
021    private final List<String> lines;
022
023    /**
024     * @param text the text of the document
025     */
026    public Positions(String text) {
027        List<String> ls = new ArrayList<>();
028        int start = 0;
029        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
030            if (text.charAt(i) == '\n') {
031                ls.add(text.substring(start, i));
032                start = i + 1;
033            }
034        }
035        ls.add(text.substring(start));
036        this.lines = List.copyOf(ls);
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * @param line a line, from 0
041     * @return its text without the newline, or empty if there is no such line
042     */
043    public String line(int line) {
044        return line >= 0 && line < lines.size() ? lines.get(line) : "";
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * @return the number of lines, the last one after the last newline
049     * included
050     */
051    public int lineCount() {
052        return lines.size();
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * @param line a line of the frontend, from 1
057     * @param column a column of the frontend, from 1
058     * @return the LSP position: past the end of its line if the column is,
059     * and at the end of the document if the line is past it
060     */
061    public Position toLsp(int line, int column) {
062        if (line > lines.size()) {
063            int last = lines.size() - 1;
064            return new Position(last, lines.get(last).length());
065        }
066        String text = lines.get(Math.max(line, 1) - 1);
067        int col = 1;
068        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
069            int after = next(col, text.charAt(i));
070            // a column inside a tab is the tab
071            if (col >= column || after > column) {
072                return new Position(line - 1, i);
073            }
074            col = after;
075        }
076        return new Position(Math.max(line, 1) - 1, text.length());
077    }
078
079    /**
080     * @param position an LSP position
081     * @return the frontend's line and column there, as {line, column}
082     */
083    public int[] fromLsp(Position position) {
084        String text = line(position.getLine());
085        int col = 1;
086        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(position.getCharacter(), text.length()); i++) {
087            col = next(col, text.charAt(i));
088        }
089        return new int[]{position.getLine() + 1, col};
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * The column after a character, as the compiler counts it.
094     */
095    private static int next(int column, char c) {
096        return c == '\t' ? ((column + 7) / 8) * 8 + 1 : column + 1;
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * @param span a span of the frontend
101     * @return its LSP range
102     */
103    public Range toLsp(SourceSpan span) {
104        return new Range(toLsp(span.line(), span.column()), toLsp(span.endLine(), span.endColumn()));
105    }
106
107    /**
108     * @param span a span of the frontend
109     * @return its LSP range, widened to the character at its start if it is
110     * empty and there is one, so that every editor shows it
111     */
112    public Range toVisibleLsp(SourceSpan span) {
113        Range r = toLsp(span);
114        if (r.getStart().equals(r.getEnd())) {
115            Position s = r.getStart();
116            if (s.getCharacter() < line(s.getLine()).length()) {
117                return new Range(s, new Position(s.getLine(), s.getCharacter() + 1));
118            }
119        }
120        return r;
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * @param range a range in this document
125     * @return its text
126     */
127    public String text(Range range) {
128        Position s = range.getStart(), e = range.getEnd();
129        if (s.getLine() == e.getLine()) {
130            String l = line(s.getLine());
131            return l.substring(Math.min(s.getCharacter(), l.length()), Math.min(e.getCharacter(), l.length()));
132        }
133        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
134        String first = line(s.getLine());
135        sb.append(first.substring(Math.min(s.getCharacter(), first.length())));
136        for (int i = s.getLine() + 1; i < e.getLine(); i++) {
137            sb.append('\n').append(line(i));
138        }
139        String last = line(e.getLine());
140        sb.append('\n').append(last, 0, Math.min(e.getCharacter(), last.length()));
141        return sb.toString();
142    }
143}
